turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{Operation}

    B -->|Received document| C[ASSAY]

    C2 --> C3[Locate operative sentence]
    C3 --> C4[Report ratio and erosion direction]
    C4 --> C5[Flag missing rough edge]
    C5 --> C6[Report residue and finding]
    C6 --> C7[This is a finding, not a draft.]
    C7 --> Z[Stop]

    B -->|Draft prompt or request| D[PROVIDE]
    D --> D1{Mode stated or inferable?}
    D1 -->|No| D2[Ask for HUMAN or MACHINE mode]
    D2 --> D1
    D1 -->|Yes| E[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
    E --> F{Floor passes?}
    F -->|No| G{Missing items}
    G -->|Three or fewer| G1[Ask one question naming gaps]
    G -->|Four or more| G2[Ask three largest gaps]
    G2 --> G3[State assumptions for remaining gaps]
    G1 --> H[Wait for answer]
    G3 --> H
    H --> E
    F -->|Yes| I[Compress the prompt]
    I --> J{Cut removed specification?}
    J -->|Yes| K[Name destructive cut and revert]
    K --> I
    J -->|No| L{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    L -->|No| M{Floor still passes?}
    M -->|No| N[Return last passing version]
    N --> O[Output contract]
    M -->|Yes| I
    L -->|Yes| O
    O --> P[Ask gate question]
    P --> Q{Named human freezes?}
    Q -->|No| R[Keep negotiating]
    R --> I
    Q -->|Yes| S{Execution tools available?}
    S -->|No| T[Gate stays closed]
    S -->|Yes| U[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    U --> V{Execution result}
    V -->|Success| W[Done]
    V -->|Floor item fails| X[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    X --> I
```
